meta.name: MarketRisk — Editorial Green Brand System
meta.intent: High-level design system guidelines that allow an AI (and humans) to reliably recreate the visual style shown in the attached brand guideline screenshots across web + mobile UI.
styleSummary: Modern editorial layout: large, confident type; generous negative space; strong left-aligned hierarchy.
A calm, trustworthy color story: deep heritage green as the anchor, pistachio as the optimistic accent, bone/off-white as the paper base.
Geometric-but-soft motif: rounded rectangles, layered panels, and subtle linework patterns used as quiet brand texture—not decoration.
doNotDo: Do not introduce loud, saturated colors outside the core palette; avoid neon and heavy gradients.
Do not use dense UI, tight line-heights, or cramped spacing—this system breathes.
Do not use hard black UI chrome (pure black borders everywhere). Keep borders subtle and surfaces calm.
Do not overuse shadows; the look is primarily flat blocks with occasional soft elevation.
Do not introduce playful visual noise (stickers, doodles, loud illustrations). Keep it premium and restrained.

primary.name: Editorial clarity
primary.guideline: Use a strong typographic hierarchy (big headline, soft subtitle, short body). Layout should read like a magazine spread: deliberate alignment, calm whitespace, and clear sequencing.
primary.why: Establishes trust and makes complex topics feel understandable.

primary.name: Calm authority
primary.guideline: Let deep green be the anchor. Use pistachio as highlight and bone as the paper base. Keep contrast high for primary copy, lower for supporting copy.
primary.why: Signals credibility and stability while still feeling modern and friendly.

primary.name: Geometry with softness
primary.guideline: Prefer rectangles with rounded corners and layered panels. Use subtle line patterns and large color blocks as brand texture.
primary.why: Creates a recognizable system that feels designed, not templated.

primary.name: One idea per panel
primary.guideline: Each card/panel should communicate a single job: summary, metric, chart, action, or explanation. Avoid stuffing multiple concepts into one surface.
primary.why: Keeps the UI scalable as features grow.

primary.name: Restraint over effects
primary.guideline: Minimize heavy shadows, glows, and complex gradients. Use simple, high-quality composition instead.
primary.why: Maintains premium feel and prevents style drift.

interaction.name: Soft feedback
interaction.guideline: Hover/focus states should be subtle: slight lift, gentle tint, or a quiet ring. Motion is calm and short.

interaction.name: Clear hierarchy of actions
interaction.guideline: Primary actions are filled deep green with light text. Secondary actions are bone/white with subtle border. Tertiary actions are text-only.

color.notes: Core palette is a deep green anchor, pistachio accent, and bone paper base. Neutrals are warm and slightly desaturated to match the editorial brand pages.

usage.canvas: Use `brand.paper` or `surface.paper` as the default app background (the 'page').
usage.accentPanels: Use `brand.pistachio` for secondary panels, highlights, and supporting data emphasis.
usage.bodyCopy: Use `text.secondary` for paragraphs and `text.muted` for captions/meta.
usage.borders: Use subtle borders sparingly; avoid outlining every card.

riskRed.name: Risk Red (sample palette)
riskRed.notes: A red-forward theme ramp with neutral ramps. Includes 100–700 stops + base tokens.

mintCitrus.name: Mint Citrus
mintCitrus.notes: Soft stone neutrals + mint ramp + cool greys + citrus ramp. Includes 100–700 stops + base tokens.

sageForest.name: Sage Forest
sageForest.notes: Dusty warm neutrals + layered greens. Source ramps include 100–900 + DEFAULT.

typography.notes: Project override: use Sora as the primary font family for the app UI. It’s geometric, modern, and pairs well with the editorial layout. Keep Inter as fallback.

spacing.notes: This system is whitespace-forward. Use a 4px base scale but default to larger steps (12–40) for breathing room. Editorial layouts should feel intentionally spacious.

radii.notes: Project override: all corners are 4px across the UI (no mixed radii, no pill-only shapes).

elevation.notes: Primarily flat surfaces. Use elevation only when necessary for layering (menus, modals, floating panels). Keep shadows soft and wide.

stroke.notes: Use borders as separators, not as the main way to define cards. Prefer whitespace + color blocks.

motion.notes: Quiet, product-like motion. No bouncy easing. Keep durations short and transitions subtle.
patterns: Hover: translateY(-1px) or subtle tint shift (2–4% change), never both heavily.
Press: remove lift; slightly reduce opacity or shadow.

iconography.notes: Iconography is minimal and geometric. Prefer rounded corners, 1.5–2px strokes, and avoid overly detailed icons.
styleRules: Use rounded line caps and joins.
Prefer single-color icons that inherit from text color.
When using icon containers, use rounded-square backplates in bone or pistachio at low saturation.

imagery.notes: Photography is candid, workplace/productivity oriented, and used as cropped blocks within a grid. Avoid overly staged stock photos.
artDirection: Warm neutrals and soft daylight; avoid harsh flash or extreme contrast.
Crop images into simple rectangles; let grid do the design.
When needed, apply a very subtle green-tinted overlay to harmonize imagery with the palette (5–10%).

backgroundMotifs.notes: Use subtle rounded-rectangle linework as a quiet brand texture on deep green panels—thin strokes, low opacity, no strong contrast.

patternSpec.shapeLanguage: Large rounded rectangles and arcs that drift off-canvas; never centered or symmetrical.
patternSpec.density: Low density: 2–6 strokes per hero panel.
doNotDo: Do not create busy patterns or high-contrast line art.
Do not use small noisy shapes; keep strokes large and calm.

grid.notes: Layout should feel like a brand guideline page: strong alignment, large margins, and a consistent left text column.

brandGuidelineSpread.description: Left column for text (title + paragraph), right area for visuals (logo lockup, image blocks, color panels).
rules: Left column: big title, then short paragraph, then optional small footer meta.
Right column: 1–3 strong blocks (image, logo, color panels) aligned to the grid.
Use big whitespace above and between sections—do not fill every area.

sectionCover.description: Deep green panel with subtle line motif, large title, and a thin numeral in the top-right.
rules: Top-right: section number in a thin weight, very large size.
Bottom-left: small meta line (e.g., 'MarketRisk × Studio' or URL).

appShell.notes: For the product UI, keep the same calm editorial vibe: paper canvas, green headers for emphasis, and card/panel surfaces with rounded rectangles.

backendOverviewDashboard.notes: Analytics/backend overview page: a comprehensive dashboard combining metrics, charts, and activity feeds in a single-page layout. No sidebar navigation; uses standard container width.

structure.purpose: Greet user, show page title, provide time range controls
Top-level business metrics at a glance
Product performance, traffic sources, recent activity
User growth trends and top pages

designRules: Use white cards for all content sections (no dark panels on this page)
All cards use border-subtle, no shadows by default
Hover states on cards: subtle lift + soft shadow
Use existing chart components (SimpleBarChart, DonutChart, PerformanceBar)
Status indicators use green (success), amber (warning), blue (info)
Keep text hierarchy: 32px page title, 18px section titles, 16px card titles

logo.primaryLockup: Rounded-square icon + wordmark to the right.

wordmark.style: Clean sans, medium/semibold weight, tight-ish tracking.

icon.shape: Rounded square container with an inset rounded square and a checkmark motif.

colorUsage: On deep green backgrounds: wordmark and icon details should be light (white/bone).
On bone/paper backgrounds: wordmark can be mughal green; avoid pure black for the logo.
logo.clearSpaceRule: Maintain at least 1× icon height of clear space around the full lockup.
doNotDo: Do not stretch the logo or change corner radii.
Do not add outlines/shadows to the logo.
Do not place the dark logo on dark green; use inverse.

Panel.description: The primary composition unit (like the big blocks in the brand pages). Used for hero sections, key summaries, and feature blocks.
rules: Use panels to create large, confident blocks of meaning.
Use very little internal clutter: title, short text, and one key visual element.

Card.description: Smaller surface for UI elements (lists, forms, charts).

Button.description: Rectangular-with-rounding buttons. Primary buttons are deep green; avoid overly pill-shaped buttons unless intentionally used for small chips.

Tag.description: Small chips used for status/category; these can be pill-shaped.

DataViz.description: Charts should be simple, rounded, and quiet—matching the editorial tone.
rules: Prefer clean bars/lines with rounded ends.
Use mughal green for primary series; pistachio for secondary; bone for background tracks.
Avoid heavy gridlines; if needed, use very subtle lines (`border.subtle`).

BackendMetricCard.description: Large KPI card for backend overview dashboard. More prominent than standard metric cards with hover animations.
content: Label: text 13px, color text.muted, medium weight
Value: text 28px, color text.primary, semibold weight, -0.5px letter-spacing
Badge: small pill showing change percentage, success/danger colors

QuickStatRow.description: Compact stat row for Quick Stats panel. Label + value + trend in a single row.
content: Trend: text 12px, color based on direction (success/danger)

ProductRow.description: Product performance row showing name, sales, and revenue on bone background.
content: Name: text 13px, color text.primary, medium weight

ActivityItem.description: Activity feed item with status indicator dot and timestamp.
content: Indicator dot: 8px circle, colors: success (green), warning (amber), info (blue)

SystemStatusIndicator.description: Small panel showing system operational status with live indicator.
content: Header with live dot (pistachio green) + label

tone: Avoid hype language; focus on clarity and trust
Short sentences; one idea per paragraph
headlines: Use simple, declarative headlines ('Risk Overview', 'Exposure Trends').
Avoid long marketing taglines in-product; keep marketing copy on landing pages.
numbers: Use clear formatting (grouping separators, consistent decimals).
Prefer highlighting deltas with subtle color and short labels rather than heavy iconography.

focus.rule: Every interactive element must have a visible focus ring.

contrast.rule: Ensure WCAG AA contrast where practical. On green panels, default to white text. Avoid muted text on pistachio when readability suffers—use darker text.

hitTargets.rule: All tap targets should be at least 44px in either dimension.

priorityOrderWhenBuilding: Establish the canvas: `paper` background, wide margins, editorial spacing.
Set type hierarchy: big titles, softer subtitles, restrained body copy.
Use large panels (green/pistachio/bone blocks) to structure the page before adding fine UI components.
Keep corners rounded-rectangle (not sharp, not overly pillowy).
Add subtle line motif only as background texture on green panels (low opacity).
compositionChecklist: Is there a clear left-to-right hierarchy (text column vs visual column) when appropriate?
Are margins generous (desktop padding ~64px) and sections well separated (~64px gap)?
Is deep green used as an anchor, not everywhere?
Are there 1–3 strong blocks per view (not 10 small boxes)?
allowedCustomization: Small adjustments to spacing for responsiveness.
Adding new component variants only if they reuse the same tokens and shape language.
Data viz colors may introduce 1–2 muted supportive tones derived from pistachio/bone if needed, but keep the system cohesive.
avoidStyleDrift: Do not introduce new font families.
Do not introduce saturated blues/pinks/purples for UI chrome.
Do not switch to dense, table-heavy layouts without panels and whitespace.
